chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, when the prayer over a deceased person had passed him by, would pray over his grave.

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: It was missed by him or passed him by
key_terms.قَبْرِهِ: His grave, where the prayer was then offered
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةُ: The funeral prayer being referred to here

ai.seo_question: Can the funeral prayer be performed at the grave if it was missed before burial?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله would perform the funeral prayer at the grave if he had missed offering it before burial. It indicates the legitimacy of salat al-janazah being performed over the grave in such a case.
